Hi Marta / ACME procurement team,

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Per our discussion, I wanted to line up the proposed path for your retainer billing and how that maps to GCP Marketplace invoicing and co-sell credit attribution. Goal is to make sure your finance and cloud teams have a clear end-to-end picture before we push the listing live.

Summary of asks (short):
- Confirm whether you prefer Redwood to invoice monthly (direct invoice) or to process via GCP Marketplace billing (marketplace-managed invoice).
- Confirm the legal/billing name and remit address for the SOW.
- Confirm how co-sell credit will be handled on your side (internal rebate vs. marketplace credit).

Attached: a draft mapping document that shows a suggested mapping from our retainer line items to expected Marketplace SKU/invoice lines (gcp-retainer-to-invoice-mapping.xlsx). Also attaching the list of technical questions your cloud team flagged (rd-cloudops-questions.docx).

If it helps, Karthik (cc'd) can call out the exact invoice line samples we expect from GCP Marketplace. Vanessa will help coordinate the DocuSign SOW once we have confirmation.

Proposed next step: if you can reply with preferred invoicing path and any constraints by EOD Monday, we will produce a final SOW and DocuSign route. If you'd rather take a quick 20-minute call, I can book time.

Thanks,

Logan — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. A few things from procurement and cloudops before we proceed: 

1) Invoicing preference: procurement prefers invoices via GCP Marketplace if possible because it simplifies internal vendor reconciliation and allows us to centralize cloud spend. However, we need to confirm how the retainer lines will appear on the marketplace invoice (line-item granularity).

2) Co-sell credit: Can you confirm whether the co-sell credit would appear as a separate line on the GCP invoice or if it's handled off-invoice as a credit between vendors? We need to know what to expect in our accounting system.

3) Timing & taxes: Our AP team needs to know whether Marketplace invoices will follow GCP's monthly billing cycle (yes/no). Also, how do you handle sales tax / VAT for marketplace purchases?

4) SOW signature: we prefer the SOW routed to procurement@acme-analytics.com.

We can do a 20-min call Monday AM if that's helpful — available 9:00–11:00 PT. 

Thanks,

Subject: Re: GCP marketplace: retainer -> invoice path & co-sell billing workflow

Hi Marta — quick answers inline to your questions and next steps below.

1) Marketplace invoice line items: when you publish on GCP Marketplace, the Marketplace will surface SKU-level lines. In practice that maps to the SKU(s) we register for the retainer bundles. I've attached a proposed mapping (gcp-retainer-to-invoice-mapping.xlsx) with example lines we expect to see in the monthly invoice. The attachment is the working version; happy to adjust labels to match your GL codes.

2) Co-sell credit: co-sell credit is typically processed off-invoice as a partner settlement between Redwood and ACME (i.e., you will not see a negative credit line from GCP on your customer invoice). We can provide a monthly report showing the partner credit applied to your invoices if you need internal reconciliation lines. If ACME requires an on-invoice credit, we can discuss a custom arrangement but it often requires marketplace reseller configuration.

3) Timing & taxes: Marketplace invoices follow Google's monthly cycle; the charge date will reflect GCP's billing cutoff. For taxes, GCP handles collection in their invoice where applicable; if there are local tax implications for Redwood as the vendor, we'll list tax details on our SOW and settlement reports. If you need VAT invoices with specific VAT IDs, share those and we'll confirm with marketplace ops.

4) SOW routing: noted — we'll route DocuSign to procurement@acme-analytics.com. Vanessa will start the routing once the final billing path is confirmed.

Attached: updated mapping (gcp-retainer-to-invoice-mapping.xlsx) with a second tab showing example GL mappings + a short note answering the co-sell process.

If it helps, Karthik can drop a short note below with a sample invoice line format we see from customers. Otherwise, let's plan the Monday 9:30 PT call. I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,

Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
